evidence: src/rebar/_config_sections.py:42: `if isinstance(value, str) and not value.strip():` — only bare empty/whitespace triggers the fault

src/rebar/_config_coercion.py:219-224: `_as_str_tuple` does `items = [p.strip() for p in v.split(",")]` then `return tuple(x for x in items if x)` — a comma-only or whitespace-comma string yields `()`

advisory.finding: For the tuple key `mcp.auth_required_scopes`, `_reject_empty_env_fault` only rejects values that are empty/whitespace after `.strip()`, but `_as_str_tuple` splits on commas and drops empty entries, so an env override of `","` or `" , "` produces an empty tuple `()` — the exact protection-disabling outcome (required_scopes=None) the ticket set out to reject — while passing the guard.
scenarios: A compose/systemd/k8s env block sets `REBAR_MCP_AUTH_REQUIRED_SCOPES` from a `${VAR}` that expands to a stray comma or whitespace, silently erasing the file-configured scope requirement without raising.
advisory.suggested_fix: For the tuple-typed protection key, evaluate emptiness after coercion semantics: reject when the value, split on commas and trimmed, has no non-empty entries (i.e. `_as_str_tuple(value, key)` would be `()`), rather than only when `not value.strip()`.

evidence: src/rebar/_config_sections.py:42 `if isinstance(value, str) and not value.strip():` — guard only fires on blank strings
src/rebar/_config_coercion.py:219 `items = [p.strip() for p in v.split(",")]` then line 224 `return tuple(x for x in items if x)` — `","` coerces to `()`

advisory.finding: The empty-env guard for the tuple key `mcp.auth_required_scopes` only rejects whitespace-only strings; a comma/whitespace-only env value (e.g. `REBAR_MCP_AUTH_REQUIRED_SCOPES=","`) passes the `value.strip()` check but `_as_str_tuple` drops the empty entries to `()`, which mcp_server.py resolves to `required_scopes=None` — silently disabling scope enforcement, the very protection the guard aims to preserve.
scenarios: An operator sets `auth_required_scopes` in rebar.toml; a mis-expanded env override `REBAR_MCP_AUTH_REQUIRED_SCOPES=","` slips past validation and disables MCP scope enforcement instead of erroring
advisory.suggested_fix: For tuple/list keys, apply the empty check to the coerced result (or strip commas/whitespace before the emptiness test) so any env value that normalizes to an empty collection is rejected.
